summary_en: 450,000 shares (3.03% of shares outstanding), ¥900M upper limit, open-market acquisition on ToSTNeT, 13 July – 31 August 2026. Stated rationale: capital efficiency, strategic optionality in M&A, and executive incentive plans.
title_en: Notice of Resolution on Acquisition of Treasury Shares
translation_en_brief: Aidma Holdings announced on 10 July 2026 that its board has resolved to acquire up to 450,000 shares (3.03% of shares outstanding excluding treasury) for a maximum of ¥900M via open-market purchases on the Tokyo Stock Exchange. The acquisition window runs from 13 July through 31 August 2026. The company states the purpose as improving capital efficiency and shareholder returns, maintaining flexibility in response to changing business conditions, using treasury shares for M&A activity, and supporting executive equity incentive plans.
